forecast.today: Cloudy at first with outbreaks of rain in eastern parts, heavy and persistent at times. Some patchy mist and hill fog also. Drier conditions with scattered showers, already in the west, will extend to all parts this afternoon and sunny spells will develop. A few may turn heavy. Highest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees in mostly light northerly winds, gradually backing westerly.
forecast.tonight: A mix of cloud and clear spells at first tonight with isolated showers. Mist and fog patches will form. Cloud will increase from the west overnight, bringing more widespread showers. Some will be heavy and possibly thundery. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 15 degrees. Mostly light westerly winds will back south to southeast overnight and freshen near the southwest coast towards morning.
forecast.tomorrow: A good deal of cloud about at first on Sunday with widespread showers. Some will be heavy and prolonged with a risk of thunder and localised flooding. Sunny spells will develop through the day. Highest temperatures of 16 to 19 or 20 degrees. Light to moderate east to southeast winds, fresh at times near coasts, will become west to northwest through the afternoon and evening. Winds may increase strong near the west coast in the evening.
forecast.solar_uv: Low to moderate today and on Sunday.
